summary: Ktor foundation on `:server`: environment config, SQLite WAL single-writer/multi-reader pool (NFR-03), JSON body limit (1 MB), trusted `127.0.0.1` forwarded headers, graceful SIGTERM shutdown, `GET /api/health`, unified JSON errors, and PII-free request logging. **Server only** — no auth routes, no schema v0.2, no UI.
overview:
First delivery slice for the Muixeranga management API. Turns the current scaffold (`GET /` hello on `0.0.0.0`) into a production-shaped JVM 21 process: read env per `docs/especificacion-tecnica.md` §9.1, bind `APP_HOST` (default `127.0.0.1`), enforce NFR-03/05/06/10, expose `GET /api/health` without auth, and install cross-cutting plugins future routes will reuse.

**Source of truth:** `docs/especificacion-tecnica.md` v1.3 §6.1, §6.3, §8, §9.1 · `docs/decisiones.md` (Google OIDC + own sessions later — **not** Firebase).

**Goals**
- Fail fast on startup when mandatory env vars are missing or `JWT_SECRET` has fewer than 32 decoded bytes.
- `GET /api/health` → `200 {"status":"ok","version":"…","db":"ok"}` or `503` if SQLite fails `SELECT 1`.
- Unified JSON error envelope per §6.3 (`code`, `message` in Valencian, optional `fields`, optional `current`), using `:core` `ApiErrorResponse` once available or created minimally in `:core` and extended by `platform-core-contract`.
- Enforce 1 MB body limit for JSON requests (NFR-05), exempting multipart upload routes configured later in `platform-files`.
- Trust `X-Forwarded-For` / `X-Forwarded-Proto` **only** when the direct peer is `127.0.0.1` (Caddy reverse proxy, §6.10).
- CORS configured from `CORS_ORIGINS` with `allowCredentials = true` (never `*` with credentials) plus open `GET` CORS without credentials for `/api/v1/public/*`.
- Single-writer SQLite connection + concurrent reader connections under WAL with `foreign_keys = ON` and `busy_timeout = 5000` (NFR-03).
- Sanitized `CallLogging`: one line per request (`method`, `path`, `status`, `durationMs`, `userId` from a shared `AttributeKey` populated by auth slice) — never tokens, cookies, or request bodies.
- Graceful shutdown on `SIGTERM` closing Netty and SQLite pools cleanly (NFR-10).
shared_ui_policy: No UI in this slice. Server-only infrastructure; shares minimal `ApiErrorResponse` in `:core`.
out_of_scope:
- Google OIDC auth, JWT issuance, `/api/v1/auth/*`, `/api/v1/me*` (`platform-server-auth`).
- Schema v0.2 migrations (`platform-schema-v02`) and business REST routes.
- OpenAPI/Swagger and deploy scripts (`platform-openapi-deploy`).
- Rate limiting (`platform-rate-limits` and auth slice).
- File storage / multipart uploads (`platform-files`).
- All client apps (web, Android, desktop, iOS).

auth.server: No authenticated routes yet. Parse and validate `JWT_SECRET`, `JWT_SECRET_PREVIOUS`, `GOOGLE_CLIENT_IDS`, `GOOGLE_JWKS_URL`, `COOKIE_DOMAIN`, `BOOTSTRAP_ADMIN_EMAIL` in `EnvConfig` for `platform-server-auth`. Expose `RequestUserIdKey: AttributeKey<String>` so auth can attach `userId` for `CallLogging`.

components.name: ApplicationKt
components.usage: Entry `embeddedServer(Netty)`, graceful shutdown hook, `Application.module(config)` plugin install order.

components.name: Database.openDatabase
components.usage: Expose `DatabaseAccess` with Flyway migrate, dedicated single-writer SQLite connection/dispatcher (for transactions) and reader pool (WAL + `foreign_keys=ON` + `busy_timeout=5000`).
components.notes: Keep schema unchanged in this slice; `platform-schema-v02` updates migrations.

components.name: EnvConfig
components.usage: Load and validate all §9.1 env vars; fail fast with clear message when mandatory vars are missing or invalid.
components.notes: Provide `EnvConfig.fromEnv(env)` and a test helper factory in `:server:test` so tests never need real VPS secrets.

components.name: ApiError / ApiErrorResponse
components.usage: Shared `@Serializable` §6.3 error envelope (`code`, `message`, optional `fields`, optional `current: JsonElement`).
components.notes: Reused and extended with `ErrorCodes` in `platform-core-contract` — do not duplicate.

components.name: ErrorHandling
components.usage: `AppException` hierarchy + Ktor `StatusPages` mapping known errors, bad JSON (`400 invalid_json`), body too large (`413`), and unknown exceptions (`500 internal_error` without stack traces).

components.name: TrustedProxyPlugin + RequestLogging
components.usage: Extract client IP from `X-Forwarded-For` only when remote host is `127.0.0.1` / `::1`; configure `CallLogging` with `RequestUserIdKey` and zero PII/tokens.

components.name: JsonBodyLimitPlugin
components.usage: Reject non-multipart request bodies exceeding 1 MB with `413` per NFR-05.
components.notes: Multipart routes enforce per-endpoint file limits in `platform-files`.

components.name: ServerModules
components.usage: Koin root module providing `EnvConfig`, `DatabaseAccess`, and shared `Json`.

structure:
Server-only Ktor plugin pipeline:

```text
Application.module(config)
  ├─ EnvConfig validation (fail-fast)
  ├─ Koin (ServerModules: EnvConfig, DatabaseAccess, Json)
  ├─ TrustedProxy (trust X-Forwarded-* only from 127.0.0.1)
  ├─ CallLogging (method, path, status, duration, RequestUserIdKey — no PII)
  ├─ ContentNegotiation (kotlinx.serialization JSON UTF-8)
  ├─ JsonBodyLimitPlugin (1 MB for non-multipart)
  ├─ CORS (CORS_ORIGINS + allowCredentials; open GET for /api/v1/public/*)
  ├─ StatusPages (ErrorHandling → ApiErrorResponse)
  └─ routing
       ├─ GET /api/health
       └─ route("/api/v1") { /* future slices */ }
```

sections.title: Environment validation rules (§9.1)
sections.description: Mandatory variables checked on startup: `DB_PATH`, `FILES_DIR`, `JWT_SECRET`, `GOOGLE_CLIENT_IDS`, `PUBLIC_BASE_URL`, `CORS_ORIGINS`. Optional variables with defaults: `APP_PORT=8080`, `APP_HOST=127.0.0.1`, `JWT_SECRET_PREVIOUS=null`, `GOOGLE_JWKS_URL=https://www.googleapis.com/oauth2/v3/certs`, `COOKIE_DOMAIN=null` (omitted in local dev → host-only cookie), `ENABLE_API_DOCS=true`, `BOOTSTRAP_ADMIN_EMAIL=null`, `DIPU_CATALOG_LIMIT=5`, `LOG_LEVEL=INFO`.
sections.behavior: Validate `JWT_SECRET` has at least 32 raw bytes (attempt Base64 decode first; if valid Base64 use decoded length, else UTF-8 byte length; fail clearly if `< 32`). For local runs, developers supply a `.env` file or env vars; there are no silent insecure defaults for `JWT_SECRET` or `GOOGLE_CLIENT_IDS` in production startup. Tests inject `EnvConfig` directly via constructor.

sections.title: SQLite concurrency pool (NFR-03)
sections.description: Wrap `openDatabase()` in `DatabaseAccess` exposing `read { }` (bounded reader pool on `Dispatchers.IO`) and `writeTransaction { }` (serialized single-writer connection/mutex on `Dispatchers.IO`) so concurrent requests never hit `SQLITE_BUSY` write races while reads stay fast.
sections.behavior: Every connection enables `PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON`, `journal_mode = WAL`, and `busy_timeout = 5000`. On `ApplicationStopped` / `SIGTERM`, drain and close connections cleanly.

sections.title: Logging and error contract (NFR-06, §6.3)
sections.description: Logback outputs plain text lines to stdout (captured by journald) respecting `LOG_LEVEL`. Format includes HTTP method, path (without query secrets), status, duration in ms, and `call.attributes.getOrNull(RequestUserIdKey) ?: "-"`.
sections.behavior: Never log `Authorization`, `Cookie`, `Set-Cookie`, or request/response bodies. `StatusPages` maps `BadRequestException` / `SerializationException` → `400 invalid_json`, `AppException` → its status/code/fields/current, and any unhandled `Throwable` → `500 internal_error` (stack trace logged server-side only, never returned to client).

endpoints.name: Health check
endpoints.notes: No auth. Returns `200 {"status":"ok","version":"1.0.0","db":"ok"}` when `SELECT 1` succeeds, else `503 {"status":"error","version":"1.0.0","db":"error"}`.

persistence: Reuses existing SQLite file via `DB_PATH` and Flyway startup through `openDatabase()`. Adds NFR-03 single-writer/reader pool wrapper without changing `.sqm` files in this slice.

Enable `kotlinx.serialization` plugin in `:core` for `ApiError`.
acceptance_criteria: No banned dependencies (Firebase, Exposed, Hilt, Retrofit)

tasks.title: EnvConfig §9.1 fail-fast loader
tasks.spec: Create `config/EnvConfig.kt` reading all §9.1 variables, validating mandatory vars, `JWT_SECRET` ≥ 32 bytes, `CORS_ORIGINS` non-empty list, `DIPU_CATALOG_LIMIT > 0`. Provide clear startup error messages listing missing/invalid vars.
acceptance_criteria: Unit tests verify missing mandatory var throws clear exception
Unit test verifies short `JWT_SECRET` (< 32 bytes) fails startup

tasks.title: DatabaseAccess single-writer + reader pool (NFR-03)
tasks.spec: Refactor `Database.kt` to expose `DatabaseAccess` wrapping Flyway migration, a single-writer JDBC connection/driver serialized on `Dispatchers.IO`, and reader connections with WAL + `foreign_keys=ON` + `busy_timeout=5000`. Add `ping(): Boolean` executing `SELECT 1` and `close()`.
acceptance_criteria: `DatabaseTest` passes with concurrent read + write coroutines without `SQLITE_BUSY`
WAL and `foreign_keys=1` verified on both reader and writer connections

tasks.title: Koin, TrustedProxy, CORS, JsonBodyLimit, CallLogging
tasks.spec: Create `di/ServerModules.kt`, `http/TrustedProxy.kt` (trust `X-Forwarded-For` only from `127.0.0.1`/`::1`, expose `resolvedClientIp()`), `http/JsonBodyLimitPlugin.kt` (1 MB limit for non-multipart), and wire plugins in `Application.module(config)`. Configure CORS from `config.corsOrigins` with `allowCredentials = true`, plus open `GET` CORS without credentials for `/api/v1/public/*`. Bind Netty to `config.host`/`config.port` with graceful shutdown on SIGTERM.
acceptance_criteria: `X-Forwarded-For` ignored when remote host is not loopback

tasks.title: ErrorHandling (StatusPages)
tasks.spec: Create `error/ErrorHandling.kt` with `AppException` and `StatusPages` mapping `AppException`, malformed JSON (`400 invalid_json`), body limit (`413 file_too_large` / `bad_request`), and unexpected exceptions (`500 internal_error` without stack trace) to `ApiErrorResponse` JSON.
acceptance_criteria: Test verifies malformed JSON returns 400 `invalid_json` with §6.3 envelope
Test verifies unhandled exception returns 500 `internal_error` without stack trace in body

tasks.title: GET /api/health + tests
tasks.spec: Add `routes/HealthRoutes.kt` mounted at `/api/health` (outside `/api/v1`). Remove legacy `GET /` hello route. Replace `ApplicationTest` with health check tests (200 ok + 503 when DB closed), body limit test, and sanitized log output assertion using a test `EnvConfig` helper.
acceptance_criteria: No tokens or PII in captured log output
